## Context / Problem
`src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/` is imported by path: `_loader.py::lazy_load`, in-package prologues and sibling loaders, and outside loaders (`_lib_ops._engine_module`, `_bridge_commands._ref_lock_module`, `mcp_server._load_engine_mode`, `infra/scripts/comment_echo_reclaim_manifest.py:28-39`, four `sys.path.insert` sites, `engine_env`'s PYTHONPATH prepend). The generic top-level name breaks namespace hygiene, forces a `sys.modules` key contract onto ~340 test files, and widens `rebar_reconciler.` annotations to `Any`. Operator decision (2026-09-06), BREAKING: it becomes `rebar.reconciler`, no shim (ADR 0083, ADR 0111). Cites on origin/main 7c426ddd71a; per-file lists in the revision-2 comment.

## Approach
1. `git mv src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler src/rebar/reconciler`; a throwaway codemod over `src`, `scripts` (incl. `.sh`), `infra`, `tests`, docs and `README.md` rewrites imports, `-m rebar_reconciler` launches, quoted keys, path joins (the package is now the engine dir's sibling) and prose. Every sibling cache key, prefixed (`rebar_reconciler_<x>`) or bare (`pass_support`, `reconcile_helpers` in `apply_phase.py`/`persist_phase.py`), becomes `rebar.reconciler.<mod>`. Test dirs `tests/{unit,integration}/rebar_reconciler/` keep their names (next story).
2. In-package: delete `_loader.py`; prologues and sibling loaders become `importlib.import_module("rebar.reconciler.<mod>")` or plain imports, keeping loader function names as patch seams (`__main__._load_sibling_keyed`/`_try_load_step` included); drop `__main__`'s `rebar` bootstrap fallback. Three fallbacks are by-path artifacts and go: the reconcile-absent no-op, `_advisory = None` on `ImportError`, and `manifest_renderer`'s `retry_budget = None`. Every module ships in the package, so a missing one raises `ImportError` (out of `run_pass_result`, or at import for `manifest_renderer`): exit 1, the unrecoverable-error contract, never a silent converged pass. NEW test `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/orchestrate/test_main_entry.py::test_missing_pipeline_module_raises_instead_of_converging` (reconcile step and advisory lock each patched to raise) pins it; `test_run_pass_returns_0_when_all_steps_absent` in that file pins the removed no-op and is deleted. The stderr handler installs on `rebar`; the package NullHandler goes.
3. `engine_env` only pins `REBAR_ROOT`. Launches still resolve: `_bridge_commands.py:51` runs `[sys.executable, "-m", "rebar.reconciler"]`, and `jira-capability-probe.py` (path-launched with `sys.executable`) imports `rebar.reconciler.access_check` / `.adapters.jira.acli` from that interpreter's installed `rebar`, as it already imported `rebar.*`. `engine_dir()` stays for the probe and `resources/`.
4. Delete `_lib_ops._engine_module` (src callers and six test modules switch to `import_module`: `tests/interfaces/facades/test_bridge_programmatic.py`, `tests/integration/test_ensure_project_mapping.py`, `tests/unit/test_reconciler_shadow_package_ordering.py`, `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_access_check_{client_seam,jql_backoff,transport_unavailable}.py`), `_bridge_commands._ref_lock_module`, and `mcp_server._load_engine_mode` with the unread `ctx.MODE_CAPS`/`ctx.Mode` (kwargs dropped in `scripts/gen_mcp_reference.py` and `tests/unit/test_{gen_mcp_reference,cross_session_mcp,audit_read,read_freshness_parity,plan_review_explain,bridge_projects_surfaces_heldout,mcp_plan_review_status}.py`); `sys.path.insert` sites and the `bridge_fsck_{drift,visibility}` and infra loaders become plain imports.
5. Scripts hardcoding the directory are re-pointed; `scripts/jira-pressure-test/*.sh` launch `-m rebar.reconciler` and import `rebar.reconciler.adapters.jira.adf` instead of path-loading `adf.py`.
6. `pyproject.toml` is NOT edited (an edit trips the pip-audit dependency-map lane on the advisories under unhelpful-supersmart-chrysalis). The old T201 glob stays dead; the 99 reconciler `print()` sites get inline `# noqa: T201` (`ruff --add-noqa`); follow-up likable-waterworn-willet moves the glob.
7. Type fixes `make typecheck` needs once `rebar.reconciler.*` annotations resolve, no behaviour change: `AcliClient.update_issue`'s first parameter renamed `remote_id` (the port's name; no keyword caller) and a few annotations/`assert is not None`. The two `sync-hardening-proposal` comment rewrites the docs/ADR epic assigned (`inbound_differ.py`, `apply_handlers.py`) land here; the epic's S1 line admits both.
8. Tests: by-path helpers become `import_module`; `sys.modules` seeds, namespace stubs, engine-dir constants and `sys.path.insert` go, as do the module-level shadow bridges in `tests/unit/conftest.py` and `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/conftest.py` (fixtures stay); private copies become `monkeypatch.setattr` on the shared module (no `reload`). `tests/_engine_path.py`, `_one_engine_root` and `test_engine_root_convention.py` stay, re-pointed at `src/rebar/reconciler` (next story deletes them). `tests/unit/test_engine_dir.py` asserts `rebar_reconciler` is not importable and that submodules resolve under `src/rebar/reconciler/`.
9. Docs spell `rebar.reconciler`; `docs/architecture.md`'s package-layout section describes it; BREAKING entries in `CHANGELOG.md`/`docs/release-notes.md`; regenerate `docs/env-vars.md`.
10. `.github/complexity-baseline.json`: re-spell the 6 engine keys under `ceilings` to `src/rebar/reconciler/...`, ceilings unchanged, via `render_baseline` (sorted). Operator-sanctioned; the CI `Complexity-baseline lock` rejects the six added keys by design and the operator force-submits.
Rollback: one atomic commit; `git revert` restores `rebar_reconciler`, every loader, the prepend and the six keys together. The old name is never importable beside the new one.

## Scope
`src/rebar/reconciler/**` (moved), the callers, scripts and prose sites in the revision-2 comment, `.github/complexity-baseline.json`, tests per steps 2/4/8, maintained `docs/*.md`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`. Out of scope: `pyproject.toml`, the rest of `_cli/`, the test-package rename (next story), engine behaviour.

## Testing
`python -c "import rebar.reconciler, rebar.reconciler.__main__, rebar.reconciler.manifest_renderer"`; `python -m rebar.reconciler --help` with no PYTHONPATH; `pytest tests/unit/rebar_reconciler tests/interfaces tests/scripts -q`; `make typecheck`; each AC command. Edge greps `git grep -nE '\brebar_reconciler\b' -- src scripts infra` and over `docs README.md ':!docs/adr' ':!docs/experiments' ':!docs/archive' ':!docs/release-notes.md'` return only the not-yet-renamed `tests/{unit,integration}/rebar_reconciler` paths.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/` does not exist (`git ls-tree`).
- [ ] `src/rebar/reconciler/__init__.py` exists and `src/rebar/reconciler/_loader.py` does not.
- [ ] `git grep -nE 'spec_from_file_location|lazy_load\(' -- src infra` returns only the `src/rebar/graph/_loader.py` docstring.
- [ ] Both edge greps match nothing beyond the listed exception.
- [ ] `test_missing_pipeline_module_raises_instead_of_converging` passes.
- [ ] `python -m rebar.reconciler preview --repo-root <tmp>` runs from a fresh venv with no `PYTHONPATH` (`tests/interfaces/facades/test_bridge_cli_heldout.py`).
- [ ] `make verify` exits 0.
- [ ] `check_complexity_baseline.py --check` prints `new=0 increased=0`, the 6 sorted `src/rebar/reconciler/` keys at unchanged ceilings.
- [ ] `ruff check --select T201 --isolated src/rebar/reconciler` reports nothing; `git diff origin/main -- pyproject.toml` is empty.
- [ ] `gen_env_registry.py --check` is clean; `git grep -n sync-hardening-proposal -- src` prints nothing.
